title: Price Stability Scoring
scenario: Calculate the Z-Score of price changes for each product.
tableSchema: products (product_id INT, new_price INT, change_date DATE)
correctQuery: SELECT product_id, change_date, (price_diff - AVG(price_diff) OVER(PARTITION BY product_id)) / NULLIF(STDDEV_SAMP(price_diff) OVER(PARTITION BY product_id), 0) AS z_score FROM (SELECT product_id, change_date, new_price - LAG(new_price) OVER(PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY change_date) AS price_diff FROM products) t;
setupSQL: CREATE TABLE products (product_id INT, new_price INT, change_date DATE);
